title: Uka Prometidos Devotos ukanaka
intro: Mä wali respetatäki uka profetaw jaqenaka taypin sarnaqäna, cheqa yatichäwir sarapjjañapatakiw jawsäna. Waljaniw qala chuymanjam kutt’apxäna, ukampis mä jisk’a dedicado círculo ukaw jawsatarux ist’apxäna ukat taqi chuymaw arsuwayapxäna. Jupanakajj pächasiñampiw yantʼasipjjäna, alajjpachan manqʼañanak thaqañsa ajjsarapjjänwa. Jupanakan jan jaytjasis Diosar taqe chuyma servipjjatapajj iyawsäwi toqet mä jan tiemponi yatichäwiruw tuküna. ¿Khitinakas jupanakajj utjäna?
clues: Mä jisk’a tamakïpxtwa, jupanakax mä divina misión ukar yanapt’añatakiw sartasipxta, kunawsatix taqinix jan iyawsäwinïpkän uka pachana.
Mä jach’añchat profetaw jutasin jawsapxitu, Allah ukan thakhipanx aliados ukham sayt’asipxañajataki.
Kunapachatï profetax khitinakas Divino ukar yanapirinakäpxani sasin jisktʼäna ukhaxa, jan pächasisaw jaysapxta.
Chuymajar chʼamañchtʼañatakejj alajjpachat saraqanir mä milagro fiesta mayiñwa jan ajjsarirïpjjayäta.
Profetasax amtayapxituw Allah jach’añchañasa chiqpach iyawsirinakäpxañäni ukhaxa, ukampirus humilde mayiwijax jach’añchatawa.
Jiwasax taqi chuyma manqhankir muyunakäpxtwa, jupanakax Isa, Maryam yuqapamp chikaw jan mayjt’ir iyawsäwimp arsuwayapxta.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
